basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old horror enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. During the day, I work as a web developer for a tech startup, but by night, I delve into the eerie and macabre corners of the internet. I have a passion for hiking and exploring the PNW trails, often sharing my experiences on Reddit. My weekends are usually reserved for catching up on Notre Dame football, a tradition passed down through my family. I'm single, and my online hours typically stretch from late evening to the wee hours of the morning.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in web development, which I honed through a combination of a computer science degree and several online courses. Additionally, my love for horror is fueled by years of reading and watching films, often discussing and dissecting these themes in forums and subreddits. I also have a fair amount of knowledge about various hiking trails and gear, gained through personal experience and community engagement.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: I'm familiar with community policies, generally adhering to them, though I'm not overly meticulous unless a post demands it. I believe in contributing positively, ensuring my comments and posts are respectful and within guidelines.
